name: BabyDogeCoin
fix_description: In swapTokensForEth, set a non-zero amountOutMin parameter instead of 0. Calculate a reasonable minimum based on oracle price or use a percentage-based slippage tolerance to prevent sandwich attacks.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a long, protocol-specific multi-step chain combining a Pancake V3 flash loan, Venus collateral/borrow logic, fee-on-transfer token mechanics, custom fee-free liquidity routing, and a sandwich around BabyDoge’s auto-liquidity behavior. Writing this PoC requires deep understanding of several interacting contracts and non-obvious state manipulation across many calls, which is well beyond a quick straightforward exploit.
